response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development but primarily with languages like TypeScript, Node.js, D, and Java rather than C++. Their background lacks direct experience with C++ in industrial automation contexts, secure development lifecycle (SDL) per IEC 62443, or multi-threaded/networked systems for automation machinery. While they demonstrate strong problem-solving and architectural skills, the misalignment with core C++ and industrial cybersecurity requirements significantly reduces their fit.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship with experience in diverse languages and paradigms (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, OOP)
Proven ability to build scalable applications, including event-driven platforms and real-time systems
Active contribution to open-source projects and technical community engagement (e.g., workshops, talks)
concerns: Limited or no direct experience with C++ in industrial automation or high-performance systems
No documented experience with IEC 62443-4-1 SDL or industrial cybersecurity standards
Background lacks exposure to on-premises/cloud platform solutions for industrial automation (e.g., message brokers, REST/MQTT for IoT)

key_factors.factor: Experience with automation machinery or distributed systems
